implementation: Independently authored TypeScript; no donor implementation, prompts, lists, thresholds, calibration values, datasets or branding copied.

reference.author: Provenance Cleaner implementation team
reference.dedication: To the extent permitted by law, the authors dedicate these independently authored synthetic reference texts to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
reference.source: Four synthetic prose examples authored for this implementation, without external corpus input.
reference.calibration: Per-metric minimum, upper middle observation, maximum of reference samples; reference sample SHA-256 hashes are computed with every profile.
reference.limitation: Demonstration reference only. No population, quality, language universality or authorship classification claim. English first-person tokens are explicitly limited.

writerCalibration.storage: Ephemeral request-local object; raw sample is not persisted by this capability.
writerCalibration.isolation: Authenticated user ID plus operation ID bind server calibration. Local-only UI uses a random session ID. Profiles expire after one hour.
writerCalibration.bands: Single-sample exact observations; no invented tolerance or borrowed calibration values.

minimumEvidence: 48 words and 4 sentence/line units, independently chosen engineering guardrails, not a statistical significance claim.
normalization: NFC, LF line endings, tabs/spaces/nonbreaking-space runs collapsed, line edges trimmed; original hashes remain distinct.
measurement: Unicode letter/number tokens; punctuation or newline sentence units; blank-line paragraphs; markdown headings/lists; documented rates; mean type/token ratio across 24-token blocks.
receipt: Original/normalized text, measurements, profile and protected-fact SHA-256 hashes. Integrity verification regenerates the entire result; hashes are not identity signatures.
